blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Persistent textual memory allows language models to carry information across long interactions, but learning what to remember is fundamentally a credit-assignment problem. A memory rewrite may only become useful many steps later, while much of the observed utility may be inherited from information already stored before the rewrite. We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which isolates the incremental value of each memory rewrite by crediting it for its marginal contribution to current and future downstream utility. This turns delayed memory utility into a direct learning signal for optimizing what information should persist. We study MGPO on document-level information extraction, where structured supervision makes the effects of individual memory updates directly measurable. MGPO improves extraction while reducing average memory length by nearly 80% relative to the initial memory policy before optimization. The learned memory policy also supports reuse and transfer across domains, downstream models without further training. These results show that effective memory learning depends not only on preserving useful information, but on identifying which memory updates create lasting incremental value.
blocks.zh: 持续的文字记忆可以让语言模型通过长长的相互作用来传递信息,但学习要记住什么从根本上来说是一个信用分配问题. 内存重写可能只是后来许多步骤才变得有用,而观测到的许多效用可能从重写之前已经存储的信息中继承. 我们引入了记忆增益政策优化(MGPO),它将每个内存的增益值通过对当前和未来下游效用的边际贡献贷记来隔离. 这使延迟的内存效用变成一个直接的学习信号,以优化哪些信息应继续存在。 我们研究关于文件级信息提取的MGPO,其中结构化的监督可以直接衡量单个内存更新的效果. MGPO改进了提取,同时在优化前将平均内存长度相对于初始内存政策减少了近80%. 学到的记忆政策还支持跨域的再利用和转让,下游模式无需进一步培训. 这些结果表明,有效的内存学习不仅取决于保存有用的信息,还取决于确定哪些内存更新创造持久的增量值.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Persistent memory allows language models to maintain information across interactions, but limited capacity requires them to selectively retain, revise, or discard stored content ( Toshniwal et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Learning such update decisions is challenging because information that appears irrelevant at the time of writing may become useful only much later ( Arjona-Medina et al., 2019 ; Han et al., 2019 ; Hung et al., 2019 ) . Moreover, even when a memory proves useful for a downstream task, its utility may be largely attributable to information inherited from the preceding memory state rather than to the most recent revision. As a result, the utility of the resulting memory does not by itself reveal how much the latest update contributed ( Setlur et al., 2025 ) . Learning what to remember thus means learning not only whether a memory update is useful now, but also its incremental value for the future beyond what the memory already knows.
blocks.zh: 持续的内存允许语言模型在相互作用中保持信息,但有限的容量要求它们有选择地保留、修改或丢弃储存的内容(Toshniwal等人,2020年;Wang等人,2023年;Yu等人,2026a; 周等人,2026年 ). 了解此类更新决定具有挑战性,因为在撰写本报告时看来无关紧要的信息可能只是后来才有用(Arjona-Medina等人,2019年;Han等人,2019年;Hung等人,2019年)。 此外,即使一个记忆证明对下游任务有用,其效用可能主要归因于从前一个记忆状态中继承的信息,而不是最近的修订. 因此,由此产生的记忆的效用本身并不表明最新更新贡献了多少(Setlur等人,2025年)。 因此,学习什么可以记住,不仅意味着学习记忆更新是否现在有用,而且意味着它对于超越记忆已经知道的未来的增益价值。

blocks.en: Existing memory systems support selective retention through retrieval ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , explicit memory management ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026b ) , and learned policies that construct and revise persistent memory ( Yu et al., 2026a ; Yan et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Yet these approaches largely leave a central learning problem unresolved. It remains unclear whether a memory update actually creates downstream value. To make the effect of memory updates measurable, we optimize a persistent memory writer against a fixed downstream reader, following prior work on upstream adaptation against frozen downstream models ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Yoon et al., 2024 ) . This leads to a more fundamental credit-assignment problem: when an updated memory improves downstream utility, how much of that utility is created by the latest rewrite, rather than inherited from the memory that already existed?
blocks.zh: 现有的内存系统通过检索(Guo等人,2025年),明确的内存管理(Chhikara等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年;Yu等人,2026年b),以及构建和修订持久性内存的学习政策支持选择性保留(Yu等人,2026年a; Yan等人, 2026a; 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-03-02. 周等人,2026年 ). 然而,这些方法在很大程度上使中央学习问题得不到解决。 记忆更新是否真正产生下游价值尚不清楚. 为了让记忆更新的效果可以衡量,我们针对固定的下游读者优化了持续记忆作家,此前曾针对冻结的下游模型进行上游适应工作(徐等人,2024年;杨等人,2023年;尹等人,2024年). 这导致了更根本的信用分配问题:当更新的内存改善下游的效用时,该效用有多少是由最新的重写所创造的,而不是从已经存在的内存中继承的?

blocks.en: To answer this question, consider a reader working through a long document with a small notebook. A natural way to assess a notebook revision is to retain both versions and compare how well the same reader performs on the same downstream tasks using each. Information already present contributes to both evaluations, so their difference isolates the change in utility attributable to the revision, following the broader principle ( Tumer et al., 2002 ; Harutyunyan et al., 2019 ; Foerster et al., 2018 ) of counterfactual credit assignment. Persistent memory also has value through future reuse. A recorded detail may offer little immediate benefit yet help interpret subsequent evidence after the original passage has left the reader’s context. This motivates long-horizon counterfactual credit assignment, where the pre- and post-rewrite memories are evaluated with the same reader and downstream target, and the paired comparison is propagated across subsequent targets that reuse the updated memory.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,考虑一个读者用一个小笔记本通过一个长的文件. 评估笔记订正本的一个自然方法是保留两个版本,并比较同一读者如何利用每个版本执行同样的下游任务。 已经出现的信息有助于两个评价,因此它们的差异隔离了因修订而产生的用途变化,遵循了更广泛的原则(Tumer等人,2002年;Harutyunyan等人,2019年;Foerster等人,2018年)。 通过未来的再利用,持续的内存也有价值。 记录的细节可能不会立即产生什么好处,但在原始段落离开读者的背景之后,有助于解释随后的证据。 这激发了长视反事实信用任务,即以相同的阅读器和下游目标来评价重写前记忆和重写后记忆,对配对的比较被传播到复用更新记忆的随后目标.

blocks.en: We propose the Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which trains the memory writer using counterfactual utility differences measured by the frozen reader across current and future downstream targets. MGPO uses these differences to credit each rewrite for its current and future utility, with policy-gradient returns accounting for subsequent rewrites along the memory trajectory. We show that the resulting return decomposes into the cumulative downstream utility minus the inherited utility of the pre-rewrite memory over the same remaining horizon. Because this inherited component is independent of the current rewrite, MGPO preserves the expected policy gradient of the underlying factual objective while changing how credit is assigned to individual memory rewrites.
blocks.zh: 我们提出"记忆增益政策优化(MGPO)"(MGPO),使用被冻结的读者所测量的当前和未来下游目标的反事实效用差异来训练记忆编写器. MGPO使用这些差异来贷记每个重写其当前和未来的用途,政策级的回报计入随后沿内存轨迹重写. 我们显示,由此产生的返回会分解成累积的下游效用,减去在同一剩余地平线上重写内存的继承效用。 由于这个继承部分独立于目前的重写,MGPO保留了基础事实目标的预期政策梯度,同时改变信用如何分配给个人内存重写.

blocks.en: We evaluate MGPO on document-level information extraction (IE), where predictions often depend on evidence distributed across distant passages ( Yao et al., 2019 ; Tan et al., 2022 ; Jain et al., 2020 ) , providing a natural setting for studying the value of memory through later reuse. Our experiments demonstrate that MGPO learns compact, effective memories that support the integration of evidence across distant passages and improve downstream extraction performance. The learned writer also transfers across unseen readers, domains, and downstream tasks, showing that the benefits of memory construction extend beyond the reader and task used during training.
blocks.zh: 我们评价MGPO的文档级别信息提取(IE),其中的预测往往依赖于分布在遥远段落中的证据(姚等人,2019年;谭等人,2022年;贾因等人,2020年),为通过以后的再利用来研究记忆值提供了一个自然的设定. 我们的实验表明,MGPO学习了紧凑,有效的记忆,支持跨远通道整合证据,提高下游提取性能. 博学的作家还跨越了看不见的读者,领域和下游任务,表明记忆构建的好处超越了读者和培训期间使用的任务.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We identify inherited utility as a central challenge in persistent memory learning. The utility of a memory state may largely reflect previously stored information, obscuring the contribution of individual memory rewrites. • We introduce Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO), which assigns each rewrite long-horizon counterfactual credit. MGPO preserves the original downstream objective while providing a more informative learning signal for memory updates. • We show that MGPO learns compact and selective memories, improves document-level information extraction, and generalizes beyond its training setting through reuse across readers and transfer across downstream domains.

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of our methodology. A trainable writer sequentially updates a persistent memory state, while a frozen reader evaluates its downstream utility. A counterfactual comparison evaluates the pre- and post-rewrite memories on the same current and future targets. Summing these utility differences yields the Memory Gain , which serves as the learning signal for optimizing the writer.

blocks.en: Persistent-memory learning faces a fundamental attribution ambiguity: state utility conflates what is inherited from prior memory with what the current rewrite contributes. MGPO isolates the latter by counterfactually comparing adjacent memory states over their downstream reuse horizon. The resulting credit is exactly potential-shaped, preserving the factual policy objective while reallocating learning signal to the rewrites that generate downstream utility.
blocks.zh: 持续的记忆学习面临一个根本的归属模糊性:状态效用将从前记忆中继承的东西与当前重写的贡献混为一谈. MGPO通过反事实比较相邻的内存状态与其下游的再利用视野来隔离后者. 由此产生的学分完全具有潜力,保留了实际的政策目标,同时将学习信号重新分配给产生下游效用的改写器。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验装置

blocks.en: Training setup. We instantiate MGPO through document-level IE and construct the target utility as an additive first-order surrogate of document-level micro-F1. Gold labels are assigned to the earliest observable chunk, yielding additive chunk-wise utilities aligned with the document-level objective. On held-out trajectories, the surrogate closely tracks the exact document-level F1 change (Spearman ρ = 0.988 \rho=0.988 ). Full derivations and scoring details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 培训设置. 我们通过文件级别IE对MGPO进行即时处理,并构建目标用途作为文件级别微F1的添加剂一阶代用. 黄金标签被分配到最早期可观测的块,产生与文件级目标相一致的添加剂块级公用事业。 在被搁置的轨迹上,代位跟踪精确的文档级别F1变化(Spearman $ = 0.988\rho = 0.988). 附录B提供了详细的推论和评分。

blocks.en: Datasets. We study document-level IE primarily on SciREX ( Jain et al., 2020 ) , which annotates Method , Task , Material , and Metric entities and their document-level structure. We optimize two tasks: salient clustering , which groups coreferent mentions involved in reported results, and binary relation extraction among salient entities. We train on the training split, select models on the development split, and report results on the test split.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们主要研究关于SciREX的文件一级IE(Jain等人,2020年),该文件对方法、任务、材料和计量实体及其文件一级结构作了注释。 我们优化了两个任务:突出的集群(Croleferent),Croleferent提到涉及报告结果的集群(Croleferent),以及突出实体之间的二进制关系提取. 我们进行关于训练分裂的培训,选择开发分裂的模型,并报告测试分裂的结果.

blocks.en: To evaluate cross-domain transfer, we use AIPAN-10K ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , a corpus of website privacy policies with annotations of mentioned data practices. Compared with SciREX, AIPAN-10K differs substantially in domain and extraction schema, and contains longer documents with denser annotations. All memory policies are trained only on SciREX and transferred to AIPAN-10K without further training or adaptation.
blocks.zh: 为了评估跨域传输,我们使用AIPAN-10K(Tang等人,2026年),这是一套网站隐私政策,并附有上述数据做法的说明。 与SciREX相比,AIPAN-10K在域和提取计划上差异很大,包含更长的文档,并带有更密集的说明. 所有内存政策都只接受SciREX的培训,并被转移到AIPAN-10K,没有再接受进一步的培训或改造.

blocks.en:
Metrics and evaluation setup. We evaluate structured IE through entity-cluster and relation extraction, where entity clusters group mentions by entity identity in SciREX
or by privacy-data and practice categories in AIPAN-10K, and relations
capture document-supported binary associations between these clusters. This evaluation provides a consistent measure of how well each memory state supports entity and relation extraction. We additionally report the official SciREX relation metric for benchmark comparability in Appendix D.1 . We report micro-pooled precision, recall, and F1 for each extraction type.
blocks.zh:
计量与评价设置. 我们通过实体集群和关联提取来评价结构化的IE,其中实体集群在SciREX中按实体身份提及
或按AIPAN-10K的隐私数据和实践类别,以及关系
抓取这些集群之间支持的文档二进制关联。 这一评价为每个内存状态如何支持实体和关系提取提供了一致的衡量标准. 我们还在附录D.1中报告了基准可比性的官方SciREX关系衡量标准。 我们报告每个提取类型的微集合精度、回忆和F1。

blocks.en: Documents are segmented into 1,024-token chunks, and the persistent memory is bounded to 256 tokens. Unless otherwise specified, all learned memory policies use Qwen3-8B and all frozen readers use Qwen3-14B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , both in non-thinking mode. Detailed scoring and implementation settings are provided in Appendix C .

(2026a) and HiMPO ( Yan et al., 2026a ) .

MemAgent and HiMPO denote results using the originally learned readers, while MemAgent 14B and HiMPO 14B use the same frozen Qwen3-14B reader as other baselines for a more controlled comparison. MGPO achieves the highest F1 among the compared methods. Relative to Direct Readout, MGPO improves entity cluster F1 by 30.9% and binary relation F1 by 60.6%. Notably, these gains coincide with a substantial reduction in the memory footprint, cutting the average memory length by 78.7% compared with MGPO-base. Thus, MGPO improves extraction while using substantially less memory, suggesting more selective and effective retention of downstream-relevant information.
blocks.zh: 表1评价了内存系统在各自培训环境下的端到端性能. MemAgent和HIMPO表示使用最初学习的读取器的结果,而MemAgent 14B和HIMPO 14B则使用相同的冷冻的Qune3-14B读取器作为其他基线进行更受控制的比较. MGPO在比较方法中实现了最高的F1. 相对于Direct Readout,MGPO将实体集群F1改进30.9%,二进制关系F1改进60.6%. 值得注意的是,这些增益与记忆足迹的大幅减少相吻合,与MGPO基数相比,平均记忆长度减少了78.7%。 因此,MGPO改进了提取,同时大量减少使用内存,建议更有选择性和更有效地保留下游相关信息.

blocks.en: The learned memory writer also transfers to a new document domain and extraction schema. On AIPAN-10K, MGPO substantially outperforms other learned memory policies without further adaptation and exceeds the next best external-memory baseline F1 by 0.4 points on entity clusters and 1.6 points on binary relations. Repetitive outputs and format violations contribute to the low extraction scores of R1-RE, MemAgent, and HiMPO. These results suggest that the writer learns to preserve downstream-relevant information beyond the scientific-document setting on which it was trained.
blocks.zh: 已学习的内存写器也转移到一个新的文档域和提取计划. 在AIPAN-10K上,MGPO在没有进一步调整的情况下大大超越了其他学习到的内存政策,并在实体集群上以0.4分和二进制关系上以1.6分超过次佳的外部记忆基线F1. 重复的产出和格式的违反导致R1-RE、MemAgent和HimPO的低提取分数。 这些结果表明,作者学会了保存与其受训的科学文件背景以外的下游相关信息。

blocks.en: 3.3 Long-horizon counterfactual credit improves memory learning
blocks.zh: 3.3 长视反事实信用改善记忆学习

blocks.en: We next ask what form of credit assignment is required to learn useful memory rewrites. We compare two reference baselines with four reward variants that isolate different aspects of rewrite-level credit. No Memory performs chunk-wise extraction without persistent memory, while Base Policy uses the unoptimized writer. Terminal optimizes only the final document score. Factual uses reward-to-go over downstream factual extraction scores without subtracting utility already present before a rewrite. Myopic also uses reward-to-go, but measures each rewrite’s marginal effect only on the current target. Full uses our proposed MGPO objective. For the specific implementation, please refer to Section C.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问,学习有用的记忆重写需要何种形式的信用分配。 我们比较了两个参考基线和四个奖励变量,这些变量隔离了重写一级信用的不同方面。 没有持续内存, 没有内存会按块进行提取, 而 Base Policy 则使用未优化的写入器 。 终端只优化最终文档分数. 事实使用对下游事实提取分数的奖励,而不减去重写前已经存在的效用。 Myopic 也使用奖励对go, 充分利用我们提出的MGPO目标. 关于具体执行情况,请参阅C.2节。

blocks.en: Before comparing the training objectives, we first examine whether the utility of an updated memory state accurately reflects the contribution of its most recent rewrite. As shown in Figure 3 , pre- and post-rewrite utilities closely track each other once memory is established, indicating that substantial utility is inherited from the preceding state. Removing this inherited component substantially changes the return, highlighting the importance of distinguishing memory state utility from rewrite-level credit. Under a fixed, untrained memory policy, MGPO reduces aggregate across-rollout gradient variance by 24.9% (95% CI: 6.4%–42.6%), supporting the role of the pre-rewrite baseline in reducing estimator variance in this setting. Full evaluation details are provided in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 在比较培训目标之前,我们首先审查更新的内存状态的效用是否准确反映其最新改写的贡献。 如图3所示,一旦内存建立,重写前和重写后的公用事业将密切跟踪,表明大量公用事业从前一状态继承。 删除这个继承的组件将大大改变返回,突出了区分内存状态用途和重写级信用的重要性。 在固定的,未经训练的内存政策下,MGPO将总和的跨推出梯度差异减少24.9%(95% CI:6.4%–42.6%),支持预重写基线在这个设定中在减少估计值差异方面的作用. 附录C.4提供了完整的评价细节。

blocks.en: The left panels of Figure 4 show that Full is the only variant that consistently improves over No Memory on both entity cluster and binary relation extraction. The key comparison is Full versus Factual : both optimize the same underlying factual objective, but Full subtracts utility already present before each rewrite using a pre-rewrite counterfactual baseline. The resulting performance gap supports the importance of attributing utility to the rewrite itself rather than to inherited memory content. In contrast, Myopic restricts marginal credit only to the current target, while Terminal provides only a sparse end-of-document signal.
blocks.zh: 图4的左面板显示,Full是唯一一个在实体集群和二进制关系提取上持续改进过No Memory的变体. 密钥比较是 Full 和 Fact : 两者都优化了相同的基本事实目标,但是完全减去了每个重写前已经存在的用法,使用前重写反事实基线. 由此产生的性能差距支持了将功用归属于重写本身而非继承的内存内容的重要性. 相比之下,Myopic只把边际信用限制在目前的目标上,而Terminal只提供少量的文件端信号.

blocks.en: The distance-stratified results in the middle and right panels further show where this improvement arises. Full achieves substantially higher precision across chunk distances, with the clearest separation in precision at longer distances and smaller differences in recall. This pattern suggests that long-horizon counterfactual credit improves the selectivity with which previously stored information is reused, particularly across distant chunks.
blocks.zh: 中间和右面板的远程测定结果进一步表明这种改进在哪里出现。 全面实现大块距离的精度大幅提高,在更远的距离上最精确的分离,在召回方面的差异较小。 这种模式表明,长距离反事实信用可以改善以前储存的信息被重复使用的选择性,特别是在遥远的块中。

blocks.en: For each learned rewrite, we compare extraction with the post-rewrite memory against the pre-rewrite memory, measuring its marginal effect on the current and subsequent targets. Figure 5 shows how these effects differ across objectives. In the top panel, Factual and Myopic often produce rewrites whose immediate and future utility are misaligned. Full shifts the distribution toward positive future utility and reduces rewrites that help the current target but hurt later ones. It also preserves rewrites with negative immediate gains but positive future rewards, consistent with learning to retain information whose value emerges through later reuse.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个学到的重写,我们比较提取和后重写内存与前重写内存,测量其对当前和随后的目标的边际影响. 图5显示不同目标之间的这些影响如何不同。 在顶部面板中,Factory和Myopic经常产生重写,其近期和未来的效用错配. 将分配完全转向积极的未来效用,并减少对当前目标有帮助、但对以后目标有伤害的改写。 它还保留了立即得到的负面收益但未来得到的正面回报的改写,这与学会保留其价值通过以后再利用而出现的信息是一致的。

blocks.en: The bottom panel shows these effects across subsequent chunks. Compared with the other objectives, Full produces stronger positive off-diagonal effects, indicating that a rewrite can continue to benefit multiple subsequent targets. These effects persist across several chunks, providing further evidence that rewrites preserve information that remains useful over time.
blocks.zh: 底部面板显示这些效果横跨后续块. 与其他目标相比,Full产生了更强的正对角效应,表明重写可以继续有利于多个后续目标. 这些影响在几个方面持续存在,提供了进一步的证据,表明改写了保留的信息,随着时间的推移,这些信息仍然有用。

blocks.en: 3.4 MGPO Learns Reusable Memory Representations
blocks.zh: 3.4 千年发展目标 学习可重复使用的内存表达式

blocks.en: A key benefit of decoupling the memory writer from the downstream reader is that the learned writer can be reused across models without retraining. As shown in Table 2 , a single MGPO-trained 8B writer, optimized with a frozen Qwen3-14B reader, improves six readers spanning four model families over their corresponding no-memory baselines. For example, entity cluster F1 improves from 34.3 to 44.5 with Qwen3-8B, from 40.0 to 51.3 with Qwen3-14B, and from 38.3 to 46.6 with Phi-4-14B. These results suggest that MGPO learns a reusable memory representation rather than a memory policy specialized to a particular reader.
blocks.zh: 让记忆作家与下游读者脱钩的一个关键好处是,学习的作家可以在不进行再培训的情况下跨模型重复使用. 如表2所示,一个单一的MGPO训练的8B编剧,用冷冻的Quen3-14B阅读器进行优化,改进了六个跨越四个模范家庭的阅读器,超过了相应的无记忆基线. 例如,实体集群F1随着Qune3-8B从34.3提高到44.5,Qune3-14B从40.0提高到51.3,Phi-4-14B从38.3提高到46.6. 这些结果表明,MGPO学会了可重复使用的记忆表现,而不是专用于特定读者的记忆政策.

blocks.en: This reuse is not limited to the downstream reader. As shown in Table 1 , the same SciREX-trained writer also transfers across document domains and extraction schemas without further optimization. We further test whether this reuse extends beyond information extraction on BABILong ( Kuratov et al., 2024 ) , where MGPO improves over the unoptimized base writer on QA3 and several QA5 settings; results are reported in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh: 这种再利用并不限于下游读者. 如表1所示,同一ScIREX训练有素的编译器也在没有进一步优化的情况下跨文件域和提取计划进行传输。 我们进一步测试这种再利用是否超出BABILong(Kuratov等人,2024年)的信息提取范围,MGPO在QA3和若干QA5设置上改进了未优化的基础写入器;结果见附录D.2。

blocks.en: Taken together, these results show that MGPO learns a reusable memory writer rather than one tied to a specific reader or training domain. Its benefits extend across reader architectures, model scales, domains, extraction schemas, and selected downstream tasks beyond information extraction.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些结果显示,MGPO学会了可重复使用的记忆写作机,而不是与特定的读者或培训领域捆绑的. 它的好处扩展到读者架构,模型尺度,域,提取计划,以及除信息提取之外的选定下游任务.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Learning and optimizing memory. Earlier approaches learn recurrent or retrieved memory representations ( Bulatov et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , while EMR uses reinforcement learning to manage bounded streaming memory ( Han et al., 2019 ) . RECOMP and PRCA train compressors or contextual adapters for fixed downstream models ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) , and CompAct learns iterative textual compression ( Yoon et al., 2024 ) . Previous methods optimize persistent memory through downstream rewards. MEM1 jointly learns reasoning and memory consolidation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , while Memory-R1, Mem- α \alpha , MemAgent, and MemPO optimize memory policies through reinforcement learning ( Yan et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026 ) . More recent methods introduce memory-specific credit signals, including hindsight-informed utility in HiMPO ( Yan et al., 2026a ) , fine-grained feedback in Fine-Mem ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , belief-entropy supervision in MMPO ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and shared-state local rerollouts in Memory-R2 ( Yan et al., 2026b ) . MGPO instead isolates the contribution of each rewrite from utility inherited from prior memory.
blocks.zh: 学习和优化记忆. 早期的方法学习了反复或检索的内存表示(Bulatov等人,2022年;Wang等人,2023年),而EMR则使用强化学习来管理有界限的流体记忆(Han等人,2019年). RECOMP和PRCA列车压缩机或固定下游型号的背景适配器(徐等人,2024年;杨等人,2023年),CompAct学习迭代文本压缩(尹等人,2024年). 以前的方法通过下游奖励来优化持续记忆. MEM1联合学习推理和记忆巩固(周等,2026年),而Mumy-R1,Mem-α\alpha,MemAgent,和MemPO通过强化学习优化记忆政策(Yan等,2026c;Wang等,2025年;Yu等,2026a;Li等,2026年). 较近的方法引入了内存特有的信用信号,包括HimPO(Yan等人,2026年a)中的后视知情效用,Fine-Mem(Ma等人,2026年)中的精细反馈,MMPO(Liu等人,2026年b)中的信仰内涵监督,以及记忆-R2中的共享状态本地回滚(Yan等人,2026年b). MGPO转而将每个重写的贡献从先前内存继承的效用中分离出来.

blocks.en: Credit assignment for RL. Dense credit assignment has been studied through process rewards for intermediate reasoning steps ( Lightman et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) and progress-based rewards that measure improvement toward eventual task success ( Setlur et al., 2025 ) . Long-range temporal credit has also been addressed through value transport, which propagates delayed rewards back to earlier decisions ( Hung et al., 2019 ) . Counterfactual credit assignment instead isolates an action’s contribution by comparing its outcome against an appropriate counterfactual baseline, as in difference rewards ( Tumer et al., 2002 ) and COMA ( Foerster et al., 2018 ) . This principle has been further developed for temporal credit assignment in single-agent reinforcement learning ( Mesnard et al., 2021 ) . MGPO extends counterfactual attribution to persistent memory, crediting each rewrite for the marginal utility it contributes across the remaining horizon.
blocks.zh: RL的信用转让. 通过对中间推理步骤的流程奖励(Lightman等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年)和衡量最终任务成功的改进进度奖励(Setlur等人,2025年),对高级信用分配进行了研究。 长期时间性信用也通过价值迁移得到了解决,这种转移将延迟奖励传播回先前的决定(Hung等人,2019年)。 相反,反事实信用分配通过将其结果与适当的反事实基线进行比较,孤立了行动的贡献,如差异奖励(Tumer等人,2002年)和COMA(Fuerster等人,2018年)。 这一原则在单一代理强化学习中得到了进一步发展(Mesnard等人,2021年)。 MGPO将反事实归属延伸至持续的内存,将每次重写为它在剩余视野中贡献的边际效用.

blocks.en: Document-level reasoning and information extraction. Document-level reasoning and information extraction require integrating distributed evidence through document graphs, localized aggregation, and reasoning-based architectures ( Christopoulou et al., 2019 ; Nan et al., 2020 ; Zhou et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2023 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) . Recent approaches address this challenge through recurrent representations ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , memory tokens ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , retrieval and graph/vector stores ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , or explicit textual memory ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . MGPO instead learns a bounded textual memory policy for deciding what to remember as context unfolds.
blocks.zh: 文档级推理和信息提取. 文件层面的推理和信息提取需要通过文件图表,本地化汇总,以及基于推理的架构整合分布式证据(Christophoulou等人,2019年;Nan等人,2020年;周等人,2021年;Ma等人,2023年;Dai等人,2026年). 最近的办法通过反复陈述(Wang et al., 2023),记忆符(Gao et al., 2024),检索和图表/数据存储(Guo et al., 2025),或明确的文字存储(Zhu et al., 2025),来应对这一挑战. 相反,MGPO学习了一种限定的文本内存政策,用于决定当上下文展开时要记住什么.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced Memory Gain Policy Optimization (MGPO) for learning persistent memory for long-horizon tasks. MGPO assigns each memory rewrite counterfactual credit according to its marginal contribution to current and future targets, providing dense supervision for optimizing what information should persist. Our experiments show that this long-horizon marginal credit produces more selective memory, improves long-range prediction, and supports transfer across readers, domains, and downstream tasks. These results suggest that learning what to remember requires crediting each memory rewrite for the downstream utility it uniquely contributes over time.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了记忆增益政策优化(MGPO),用于学习长期记忆任务. MGPO根据其对当前和未来目标贡献的边际贡献来分配每个内存重写反事实信用,为优化哪些信息应当持续提供密集的监督. 我们的实验表明,这种长视边际信用产生更多的选择性记忆,改善长程预测,并支持跨越读者,域,下游任务的转移. 这些结果表明,要学会记住什么,就必须将每个内存重新编订为它长期以来独特的下游效用。

Dataset statistics are reported in ( Table 3 ). For AIPAN-10K, gold mention boundaries are provided to isolate document-level clustering and relation extraction. blocks.en: We evaluate BABILong QA1–QA5 at 8K, 16K, 32K, and 128K contexts using 100 examples per task and length, reporting mean accuracy under the official scoring procedure. In order to test only memory capabilities, all methods use their trained memory writer, while sharing the same frozen Qwen3-14B reader.

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the deployment settings. Direct Readout and R1-RE process the entire document in a single pass. LightRAG and Mem0 construct external memory stores and provide retrieved content to a frozen reader, with the memory budget applied to the retrieved text. MemAgent and HiMPO update memory after each chunk and use either their own trained model or the shared frozen Qwen3-14B reader for readout. MGPO updates memory sequentially and uses the frozen Qwen3-14B reader for downstream predictions. We use 1,024-token chunks with a 256-token memory budget for SciREX and AIPAN-10K, and 4,096-token chunks with a 1,024-token memory budget for BABILong.
blocks.zh: 表5汇总了部署设置。 Direct Readout and R1-RE 在一个单行道中处理整个文档. LightRAG和Mem0构建了外部内存存储器,并向一个被冻结的读者提供检索内容,对检索文本适用内存预算. MemAgent和HimPO在每个块后更新内存,并使用自己训练过的模型或者共享的冻结的Quen3-14B读取器进行读取. MGPO依次更新内存,并使用冷冻的Quen3-14B阅读器进行下游预测. 我们使用1 024个托肯块,其中256个托肯内存预算用于ScIREX和AIPAN-10K,以及4 096个托肯块,其中1 024个托肯内存预算用于BABILong。

blocks.en: MGPO uses chunk-aligned targets deterministically derived from existing SciREX annotations, whereas Terminal , MemAgent and HiMPO use document-level targets. blocks.en: We train R1-RE and HiMPO with GRPO ( G = 8 G=8 ) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . For MemAgent, originally trained with Multi-Conv DAPO ( Yu et al., 2026a ) , we retain its memory mechanism and outcome reward and use the same GRPO objective to standardize optimization across these baselines. We also evaluate a Multi-Conv DAPO variant under the same data, reward, model, and training budget. On the SciREX test set, MemAgent-GRPO achieved 49.9 salient-cluster F1 and 19.2 binary-relation F1, compared with 31.7 and 10.7 for this variant. We therefore use GRPO for MemAgent in our comparison.

blocks.en: SciREX. We evaluate salient-cluster identification and binary relation extraction. Gold-span coverage is the fraction of annotated spans in a gold cluster overlapped by at least one predicted span. Binary relations are untyped and are induced from pairs of salient entities that co-occur in gold result tuples. We do not evaluate 4-ary tuple extraction, which additionally requires composing pairwise relations into globally consistent result structures.

blocks.en: AIPAN-10K. We provide gold mention boundaries to isolate document-level clustering and relation extraction. Because its clusters represent semantic categories rather than coreference identities, multiple predicted subclusters may map to the same gold category. We therefore allow many-to-one matching. Data types use normalized exact matching, while other entity types use token-F1 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 for long phrases matching. Mapped relation pairs are deduplicated before scoring.

blocks.en: For compatibility with prior SciREX work ( Jain et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2021 ) , we additionally report binary-relation scores using the unmodified TempGen evaluation script. This evaluator first maps predicted clusters to gold clusters by span overlap and then scores relations over the mapped identities, making it relatively insensitive to cluster fragmentation. We therefore use our structured IE scorer as the primary measure of entity-cluster recovery. Table 7 also reports typed-mention extraction as a diagnostic. MGPO retains 44.3 F1 despite receiving no reward on this metric, whereas R1-RE, MemAgent, and HiMPO obtain 29.4, 23.5, and 24.2 F1, respectively, consistent with reduced interference when memory learning is decoupled from the frozen reader.

blocks.en: During training, we use only chunks containing attributed gold structures as reader-evaluation targets in the counterfactual matrix. Chunks without attributed targets are still processed by the memory policy, so their rewrites remain part of the trajectory and can affect utility on subsequent supervised targets, but they are not themselves scored as target chunks. This sparse target evaluation substantially reduces the number of reader calls relative to the dense estimate in Figure 9 . Our transfer experiments further show that memory policies trained on shorter documents remain effective on substantially longer contexts, reducing the need to train directly at the longest deployment lengths.

blocks.en: Appendix G Scope and Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录G 范围和限制

blocks.en: MGPO isolates the marginal effect introduced between adjacent memory states, but does not explicitly decompose higher-order interactions among multiple rewrites. When downstream utility emerges only after several complementary updates, the newly realized gain is attributed to the rewrite at which that utility becomes observable rather than divided among the preceding contributing updates. This does not eliminate long-horizon credit to earlier actions, since subsequent Memory Gains remain included in their cumulative returns G t G_{t} . Rather, it limits the granularity of rewrite-level attribution. Explicit interaction-aware or coalitional attribution is an interesting direction for future work.
blocks.zh: MGPO将相邻内存状态之间引入的边际效应隔离,但并未明确分解多个重写之间的更高顺序相互作用. 当下游公用事业仅在几次补充更新后才出现时,新实现的收益归因于该公用事业成为可观察到的重写,而不是在前几次贡献更新之间划分。 这并没有消除对早期行动的长距离信用,因为之后的记忆增益仍然包含在其累积收益G t G_{t}. 相反,它限制了重写一级归属的颗粒性。 明确的互动意识或联合归属是未来工作的有趣方向。
